Segregación de Pedidos

The separation of orders or order lines by customer, product, or other criteria, for accurate fulfillment, shipping, or compliance with specific handling protocols in WMS.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Segregación de Pedidos?

In this glossary, Segregación de Pedidos refers to: The separation of orders or order lines by customer, product, or other criteria, for accurate fulfillment, shipping, or compliance with specific handling protocols in WMS.

How is Segregación de Pedidos used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "La segregación de pedidos garantiza que los artículos con control de temperatura se separen de los productos ambientales durante el picking para cumplir la normativa."

Why does Segregación de Pedidos matter in logistics?

Segregación de Pedidos matters because it supports clear communication in Warehousing contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses Segregación de Pedidos?

Segregación de Pedidos is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

What category does Segregación de Pedidos belong to?

In this glossary, Segregación de Pedidos is grouped under Warehousing. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

The separation of orders or order lines by customer, product, or other criteria, for accurate fulfillment, shipping, or compliance with specific handling protocols in WMS.

Operational example

Order segregation ensures that temperature-controlled items are separated from ambient goods during the picking process for regulatory compliance.

Localized term

Segregación de Pedidos

Localized example

La segregación de pedidos garantiza que los artículos con control de temperatura se separen de los productos ambientales durante el picking para cumplir la normativa.
